user_prompt: I need to pull together our current inventory specifications alongside the vendor details we have on file, and simultaneously check on the status of our pending maintenance requests and any open change orders we've submitted to understand our full operational picture.

steps.step_name: I need to retrieve our current inventory specifications and cross-reference them with the vendor details we have on file.
I need to check the status of our pending maintenance requests and review all open change orders we've submitted.

intent_resolver.reason: The user's request is a multi-faceted, ad-hoc information gathering task requiring simultaneous access to four distinct operational data sources (inventory specs, vendor details, maintenance requests, change orders) rather than execution of a single end-to-end process workflow.

sub_queries: Retrieve vendor details we have on file
Check the status of our pending maintenance requests
Get information on any open change orders we've submitted
